assignments.decisiveDefect: product-wiring.json declares the packet's primary_filing component at SHA-256 9f00da8f072069098dce0b465bbc242d5713730f5472a6f9d6a104699bd1428a. ARTIFACTS.measuredDetail: declared 9f00da8f072069098dce0b465bbc242d5713730f5472a6f9d6a104699bd1428a; recomputed from the file the record points at 2a7e3fa6eb3b583fdbddc5a365b6c2678e7a37ad0f8ebdd6b78a230eb39d98ad; the declared value reproduces exactly when the blob at db2585afb is hashed, confirming it as the pre-repair digest rather than a typo
ARTIFACTS.whatRepairMustDo: Regenerate the proposal digest from reports/rendered-artifacts.json, or fix the generator so a refreshed record refreshes it. Nine other families share the defect.
ARTIFACTS.scoringChoiceMadeVisible: A reader who takes 'the record' in the ARTIFACTS obligation to mean only the raster receipt and rendered-artifacts.json would score this PASS. This lane takes it to mean every committed record in the packet directory that names the delivered artifact's digest, because that is the record a route would be installed from, and because the dispatch asked in terms whether the wiring, the raster pin and the bytes agree. The other fourteen obligations pass on this family.

sharedGeneratorDefect.theLine: In the branch that handles an existing product-wiring.json the generator rewrites only `binding` and states in its own comment: 'its identity, its proposal and its non-grants are untouched, and only the binding is rewritten from current evidence'. So proposedRepresentation.components[].sha256 keeps whatever the first write recorded, and any family whose fixtures moved afterwards carries a digest for bytes that no longer exist.
sharedGeneratorDefect.measuredScope: 80 census-v1 product-wiring.json files declare component digests at base 4f5af4e7. 70 agree with the bytes on disk; 10 do not: pa_pardon_expungement-set, composed-treatment AK set-aside-after-a-suspended-imposition-of-sentence-as-12-55-085, ky_void_seal_marijuana_synthetic_salvia-set, ky_void_seal_controlled_substance-set, vt_seal_pardon-set, vt_seal_nonconviction-set, vt_seal_felony-set, vt_exp_decriminalized-set, ct-missed-erasure-set, va_seal_petition_misdemeanor-set.
sharedGeneratorDefect.whatRepairMustDo: Refresh proposedRepresentation.components[].sha256 from reports/rendered-artifacts.json — the file product-wiring.json already names as its own derivedFrom — whenever an existing record is refreshed, or drop the digest from the proposal and let the binding carry it alone. No packet byte moves and no re-raster is needed.
sharedGeneratorDefect.whoMayNotDoIt: Not this lane. FABLE-VC may not edit factory scripts or overlay directories; this is named, not repaired.
sharedGeneratorDefect.notAPacketDefect: The delivered canonical and boundary bytes are correct and hash exactly to the raster receipt, the RASTER_QUEUE row and reports/rendered-artifacts.json in every one of the three families this lane scored.
